title: Compact Coloristic
description: Makes text on coloristic mod buttons more compact, so you don't have to struggle with sliding text
body:
## What is this?

When I dowloaded Coloristic mod I stumbled upon a problem, that text on mod sliders is to long for them. So I wrote a simple resourcepack, that fixes that issue.

## What languages does this resourcepack support?

All of coloristic mod languages _(only ru and eng lmao)_
